recipes.name: Cheesy Chicken and Rice Casserole
ingredients_raw: 4 (5 ounce) skinless, boneless chicken breast halves - cut into bite size pieces
1 (10.75 ounce) can condensed cream of chicken soup

steps.text: Preheat the oven to 350 degrees F (175 degrees C).

Season chicken with salt and pepper; place in a microwave-safe dish. Cover and microwave on high for 5 to 6 minutes. Stir, cover again, and cook until no longer pink in the center and the juices run clear, 2 to 3 minutes more. Remove from the oven and let cool, about 10 minutes.
Transfer chicken to a 7x11-inch baking dish. Stir in rice and condensed soup until well combined. Sprinkle Cheddar over top, then bread cubes.
Bake in the preheated oven until cheese is melted and bubbly and bread cubes are toasted, about 20 minutes.

raw_recipe.headline: Cheesy Chicken and Rice Casserole
raw_recipe.description: This comforting chicken and rice casserole is both creamy and cheesy with condensed soup and Cheddar cheese. Use cooked chicken to save time.

review.reviewBody:
This is a very good basic/starter recipe, however you do need to alter it a bit. Due to having to alter it, I would have given it 4 ½ stars if it was an option but it’s not. It was a must to read others reviews for they gave very good insight as how to turn this into a 5 star recipes. I did add a few of my own ideals though.

2 cans of soup is a must (I used one can of cream of chicken and one can of cheese soup).
4 slices of bread is also a must.
I stirred fried my chicken with garlic and pepper instead of using the microwave and no garlic.
I added 1 cup of chopped onion, 2 cups of frozen broccoli and increased the cheese to 3 cups, using ½ in the mixture and the other half on top of the bread cubes. I also poured melted butter on top of the bread topping.

This was a big hit with my husband. This is a great Sunday dish for you can pre-mix it and place it in the fridge until you get home from church, and then all you have to do is bake it and fix a side salad. It is also very good for a potluck dinner.

I rated it a 5 star because the way I made it, came out excellent!!! I used 2 cans of soup: 1 chicken soup and 1 mushroom soup. Instead of cooking the chicken in the microwave I cooked it in a skillet, used 2 tbs of veggie oil and cooked it until white on both sides then added: salt, black pepper, minced garlic, garlic salt, and onion powder. The chicken came out excellent with so much flavor. I also used not only sharp chedder but 4 cheeses. I did use the bread crumbs but sprinkled it with butter and I put italian bread crumbs too. My whole family loved it and my fiance ate all of my left overs ;-)

Definitely read other alterations....everyone has altered this recipe a little differently. I personally liked the one that uses 1 can of cream of chicken and 1 can of cheddar soup. I also dried my bread a little before putting butter on it. I laid the pieces of the buttered bread on top then sprinkled cheddar cheese over it. I did not add any cheese in the mix. I personally don't think it needed any more cheese than the can of cheddar soup mixed in. Preparing this recipe was a little time consuming but I should be able to prepare this in 30 minutes now that I have made once. I will make this again...

OK, this is a great beginning. To "kick it up a notch" try adding some sliced water chestnuts, extra sharp Cheddar (3 cups instead of 2), an additional can of soup (Cheddar cheese soup or cream of celery), some milk or mayonnaise to make it more creamy, cooked broccoli, and some curry powder. Also, saute the chicken in strips with onions and chopped celery in oil or butter first, sprinkled with a little curry powder. Then mix it all together well with the broccoli and rice. Put it into a glass casserole dish. Top it with crushed Ritz crackers which have been coated with melted butter. Bake until bubbly.

I browned ground chicken(I don't microwave cook) seasoned with salt, pepper, onion, garlic.. I put the lid on to reserve some juices. Brown rice mixed with cream of chicken, seasoned with salt free garlic season mix, topped with cheddar and a sprinkling of Parmesan , no bread or crumbs...YUM

I have a little experience with recipes like this one...basic but great ingredients to build on. I used 2 cans of diced chicken, about a cup of sour cream (or plain yogurt), the can of cream of chicken soup, rice (about 2.5 cups)...I then used some celery seed, Beau Monde seasoning, garlic salt w/parsley, and diced onion or dried onion. I mixed these all together and put them in the 9x13 pan. The 2 cups of cheese were spread over the chicken mixture, but for a topping I used 1 cup of breadcrumbs mixed with 2 tablespoons of melted butter. Same cooking time, 350 for 20 minutes and voila a yummy dish to call your own. :)

After reading the reviews I altered recipe as well. I used chicken from rotisserie chicken, added garlic and onion powder and added 1 cup of light sour cream. I also used short grain brown rice instead of white rice as well as reduced fat cheddar and healthy request chicken soup. I do weight watchers and a 1 cup serving was 12 points with the substitutions.

Reading the reviews is a must for this recipe. I almost didn’t and I know I would have regretted it. I got lots of great ideas from reading the reviews and my casserole turned out great. Using two cans of cream of chicken is a must. I added a half cup of milk. I also cooked the chicken up in a skillet instead of the microwave. I added garlic powder, frozen broccoli, carrots, and corn to the mixture. I used cheese in the mixture as well as on top. Using 4-5 pieces of bread is a must. I also used butter on the bread which I think made it taste better. This recipe would be a five star recipe if the changes weren’t needed, but they most definitely are.

As others have said, this is a good base recipe that you can adjust to your own taste. I cooked the chicken in a pan, instead of the microwave, and seasoned with a pasta/pizza spice mix I have. Then, I sauteed garlic and spinach in the brownings from the chicken pan. I used brown rice instead of white, and cream of mushroom instead of the cream of chicken. When I mixed everything together, I sprinkled a little more of the pasta/pizza spices and some garlic salt in the pan. Finally, I used a nice soft rye bread from Great Harvest for the cubed bread, and drizzled olive oil on top. As the recipe goes, I gave it a 4, but with my modifications, for us, was a 5.

With a few changes this is definitely a five star recipe. Save it to your favorites for sure. I cooked the chicken on the stove with salt, pepper, and paprika. I cooked the rice in chicken broth and also added chopped onion and frozen broccoli to the mixture. I used two cans of soup and 1/4 cup milk as many others suggested. Lastly I used more cheese and mixed half of it in the casserole and the other half on top. For the bread crumbs I mixed them with 2 Tbsp melted butter. Great meal!

This is a nice, simple casserole dish. I am so glad I read the comments from the other viewers! I added/changed things up a bit as recommended. I sautéed my chicken with 2 garlic cloves and added 1/4 teaspoon chkn bouillon seasoning. I used 2 cans of crm of chkn, used the full amnt of the cooked rice, not only 2 cups. Used 3 cups of cheese to add to the soup, rice and chkn mixture. Added 1 lb of frozen broccoli. After putting the mixture in a casserole dish, I topped with more shredded cheese, added a light layer of garlic powder, topped with the cubed bread, and drizzled with butter. My husband and 1 1/2 year old liked it :)
I added Garlic powder onion powder, and celery salt to taste.
Used already cooked chicken and just Shredded it

Added 1 cup frozen mixed vegetables (icrowaved 3 minutes.) 2 cloves garlic 1t Albanian Sage 1t parsley 3 shakes ground Rosemary Sautéed diced chicken with 1 clove garlic in olive oil. Mixed seasonings with ingredients plus 1/2 t salt. Generous white pepper. Placed 1//2 cup cheese in mixture. Balance on top

I used Progresso Chicken Pot Pie Soup (it's a nice thick soup including carrots, peas & dumplings), in addition to the other ingredients called for. I did skimp on the cheese & only used a little over a cup. Next time I'll use the full 2 cups. It was a nice, stomach warming dinner.
I used 2 cans of cream of chicken cause it looked dry but my family loved it. I love getting recipes from here and I always trying something new for my family to enjoy.

Two of my kids are not chicken lovers, but this huge hit! All 7 of them LOVED it!
Definitely making again!
Thank you
This was really good, easy and fast. Even my picky husband liked it, too! The second time I made it, I used homemade, course Italian breadcrumbs and it was fantastic.

I used two cans of soup and a tad more cheese, plus some garlic powder for flavor. (and more than 3 slices of bread because I cubed up a couple hoagie rolls that were gonna go stale.) I split the recipe into two 8x8 dishes and baked for 35 min but the cheese never got bubbly. It was bland, as many other reviewers also pointed out, but not hopeless so I might tinker with it in the future.
I do like this recipe. I have used it for years. I use 2 cans of soup though to make it nice and creamy. Extra cheese, some mixed in is always tasty as well.
